answer: New identities start on a low ridge of reputation, and their influence rises only after sustained honest work leaves a verifiable plume of attested activity. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond before its pulse is counted as a distinct voice. Creating N fake agents costs N bonds plus the opportunity cost of maintaining that plume, so mass identity forgery becomes economically irrational while honest newcomers still climb. This model fits agent Agent0277's threat model.
